seen.excerpt_en: MEASURED on 2026-08-08 on the 272 JATS XML articles of the internal corpus: present in 73 (26 %). Concentration: trial 21, nonEN 12, meta 11, bio 10, phys 10. Real forms: nonEN-PMC13193189.xml carries 36 <th> with colspan/rowspan ≥2; trial-PMC13205731.xml carries 27; bio-PMC12857832.xml has 4 <thead> out of 5 with more than one <tr> row. REAL RUN of the filter (2026-08-08): of the 670 <table> in the corpus it classifies 151 as "multi-level headers", 469 as "single header", and ABSTAINS on 50 without <thead>. At document level: 71/272, against 73 for the probe — the difference of 2 comes from colspan <th> located OUTSIDE <thead>, which the filter refuses to take as a header.
